title: Ordinary pro-etale global sections and canonical section maps
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use the small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site] and the categories of modules over the constant ring sheaves $A_X,A_Y$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules]. For an $A_X$-module sheaf $M$, define $\Gamma_A(X,M)$ to be its global sections as an $A$-module: apply the inverse of the canonical fixed-scalar realization [def-weil-extension-by-zero] and evaluate at the terminal object $X\to X$. For a scheme morphism $h:X\to Y$, use the constant-section coefficient map and sectionwise direct image [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], and the tensor-unit-normalized adjunction $h^*\dashv h_*$ [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations]. Define $d_h$ to identify this adjunction's ringed direct image with the sectionwise constant-module direct image, by the adjunction round trip on its coefficient map. Define $t_h:\Gamma_A(Y,h_*M)\xrightarrow{\sim}\Gamma_A(X,M)$ by cancelling the canonical scalar-realization equivalences and evaluating base change at the terminal object $X\times_Y Y=X$. The fixed-scalar terminal identification, for the fixed-scalar sheaf pushforward [def-sfb-finite-lower-star], is induced by preservation of that terminal object. For an $A_Y$-module sheaf $N$, define the section-unit map $\Gamma_A(Y,N)\to\Gamma_A(X,h^*N)$ to be $\Gamma_A(Y,\eta_h(N))$ followed by $t_h(h^*N)$, where $\eta_h$ is the specified adjunction unit.
